## Terms

### explain plan

- **explain plan** · self — Explain plan results for queries are subject to change between MongoDB versions. · aka: explain plans, explain output, explain results, explain(), cursor.explain, db.collection.explain, explain command — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/analyze-query-plan.md

### query planner

- **query planner** · synonym — Hidden indexes are not visible to the query planner and cannot be used to support a query. · aka: query plan, query plans, planner, winning plan, winningPlan, rejected plans, rejectedPlans, candidate plans, plan selection, plan ranking — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden/

### plan cache

- **plan cache** · part — Plan cache entries have three states. Missing: no entry exists, so plans are evaluated and an Inactive placeholder with a work value is created. Inactive: placeholder, not used to generate plans. Active: used to generate plans. A newly selected plan whose work value is less than or equal to the plac · aka: planCache, plan cache entry, plan cache key, planCacheKey, planCacheClear, $planCacheStats, planCacheShapeHash, plan cache eviction, replanning, replan — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/current/core/query-plans/

### executionStats

- **executionStats** · part — executionStats.executionTimeMillis covers plan selection (including the trial phase) plus execution, excludes network transfer, and is not necessarily representative of real query time: with a cached plan or cursor.hint(), plan selection is bypassed and actual time is lower than the reported value. · aka: execution stats, executionStats mode, allPlansExecution, queryPlanner mode, executionTimeMillis, executionTimeMillisEstimate, nReturned, totalKeysExamined, totalDocsExamined, keysExamined, docsExamined, works, advanced, needTime, isEOF, usedDisk, spilledRecords — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results/

### query shape

- **query shape** · part — - Query Shape Reports are not available through the Atlas Administration API. · aka: query shapes, queryShape, query hash, queryHash, queryShapeHash, $queryStats, queryStats, query stats, query statistics, queryStatsRateLimit, planSummary — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md#limitations

### query settings

- **query settings** · part — Query settings have more functionality than index filters. Also, index filters aren't persistent and you cannot easily create index filters for all cluster nodes. To add query settings and explore examples, see [`setQuerySettings`.](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setquerysetti · aka: setQuerySettings, removeQuerySettings, $querySettings, querySettings, index filters, index filter, planCacheSetFilter, planCacheListFilters, planCacheClearFilters, persistent query settings, query hints — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md#index-filters

### hint

- **hint** · part — hint() cannot select the index for a query containing a $text expression. · aka: hint(), cursor.hint, $hint, $natural, index hint, forcing an index, force index, forced index — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.hint.md

### $indexStats

- **$indexStats** · part — $indexStats is not allowed in transactions. · aka: indexStats, index stats, index usage, index usage statistics, unused index, unused indexes, accesses.ops, dropIndex, drop unused index — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats/

### database profiler

- **database profiler** · part — Database profiler output, in the command.comment field. · aka: profiler, db.setProfilingLevel, setProfilingLevel, profiling level, system.profile, slowms, slowOpThresholdMs, slow query log, slowOpSampleRate, log slow operations, COLLSCAN, collection scan, COLLSCAN stage, slow query log, Slow query entries, slow query entries — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setindexcommitquorum/

### plan stage

### index bounds

- **index bounds** · related — **Index bounds** define the range of index values that MongoDB searches when using an index to fulfill a query. When you specify multiple query predicates on an indexed field, MongoDB attempts to combine the bounds for those predicates to produce an index scan with smaller bounds. Smaller index boun · aka: indexBounds, bounds, multikey bounds, isMultiKey, indexName, keyPattern, direction — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-multikey/multikey-index-bounds.md

### index effectiveness

- **index effectiveness** · measure · aka: measure index use, index selectivity, selectivity, keys examined ratio, docs examined ratio, examined to returned, totalKeysExamined / nReturned, index hit ratio

### $currentOp

- **$currentOp** · related · aka: currentOp, db.currentOp, killOp, long-running operations, maxTimeMS

### query optimization

- **query optimization** · hypernym · aka: query performance, optimize queries, query optimizer, analyze query performance

### index

- **index** · hypernym — Index properties affect how the query planner uses an index and how indexed documents are stored. You can specify index properties as optional parameters when you create an index. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-properties.md
